_note: Video content for /artist/live-video and the EPK. `uploadDate` is ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) and `durationSeconds` is an integer; both are converted at render time (to a human label, and to an ISO 8601 duration like PT3M58S for VideoObject JSON-LD) so the data stays machine-readable. Every field here was read off the live YouTube watch pages on 2026-07-26 — do not hand-edit durations or IDs without re-checking, because a wrong `duration` in VideoObject is a structured-data error Google will flag.
_ordering: TWO SEPARATE JOBS — do not collapse them. (1) DISPLAY ORDER is pure recency: lib/content.ts sorts every list by `uploadDate` descending, so the newest upload leads the listing regardless of where it sits in this array. The array below is kept newest-first as well, purely so the file reads the way the page renders; array position itself is never load-bearing. (2) `bookingLiveVideoSlug` is an EDITORIAL PIN, not a sort result. It is the video a talent buyer is sent to from a booking email, and it must be a genuine full-song live performance — a buyer needs to see her perform live, so pinning a studio/official video there would defeat the entire purpose of the link. The build enforces `kind: "live-session"` on it (see lib/content.ts). If a newer full-song LIVE capture appears, repoint this slug; do NOT repoint it at a music video just because a music video is newer.
_thumbnails: YouTube only generates maxresdefault.jpg (1280x720) for some uploads; the 2018 live sessions for `mapa-ni-reloj` and `lejos` only have sddefault.jpg (640x480, 4:3 with letterbox bars). Both are rendered into a 16/9 frame with object-fit:cover, which crops the bars. Verified availability per-ID before choosing the URL — a 404 poster would break the click-to-load facade.
_todo: UNVERIFIED CANDIDATE — deliberately not added. Juliana rated this video highly and wants it considered: Google Drive file ID 12wRDGZGvWabQgRuWUPsqwUQC135nztUd (https://drive.google.com/file/d/12wRDGZGvWabQgRuWUPsqwUQC135nztUd/view). The file is private — an unauthenticated fetch on 2026-07-26 hit a Google sign-in wall and leaked only the filename `IMG_2678.MOV`, so nothing about the content could be confirmed. Before it can be listed here, somebody with access must establish: whether it is a genuine full-song LIVE performance or a clip/studio piece, its real title, its exact duration, and a public hosting URL — this schema assumes a YouTube ID and an i.ytimg.com poster, and a Drive file cannot be embedded through the existing click-to-load facade. If it turns out to be a newer full-song live performance, it is the obvious candidate for `bookingLiveVideoSlug`. Do not invent an entry from the filename.

videos.description: Juliana Beltran performs her original song "Quédate a Mi Lado" live with a full band — drums, guitar, keys and bass — in a single-take live session produced by Juan Galeano Toro. Full song, live vocal, no overdubs.

videos._comment: BOOKING PIN (`bookingLiveVideoSlug`) — the one a talent buyer should watch, deliberately surfaced above the chronological listing rather than sorted into it. It is the longest of the four live sessions (3:58), a complete song rather than a clip, a live vocal over a live four-piece band, and it has the strongest audio of the set. It is also the only 2018 live session with a 1280x720 thumbnail, which matters both for the facade poster and for VideoObject rich-result eligibility. Caveat for whoever maintains this: it was filmed in 2018 and is Spanish-language, and two 2026 official videos are now newer. Recency is handled by the display sort — it is not a reason to move this pin. Only a newer full-song LIVE capture should replace it.
